data.subject: Local Ledger four-week pilot
data.body:
Daytona Street Capital's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in CFBK and FSBW.

PLBC reported Q2 2026 total interest income of $30.4M versus $20.6M a year earlier (+47.1% y/y), according to its filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1168455/000143774926025819/0001437749-26-025819-index.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent public-records research service. I can send the free weekly issue and set up a four-week fund pilot.

Andrew

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
